Sentence (English): Such a bummer how cheaply made appliances are these days.
Comments (English): [ After 8 months it has quit working ] || ---------------- || Such a bummer how cheaply made appliances are these days. I bought this 8 months ago to replace my other more expensive dishwasher that only lasted 5 years. This one has worked fine for a basic dishwasher. Then a few weeks ago I noticed there was rust on the bottom front of the stainless finish. I felt annoyed but thought I would look into it later since it was running fine. Then last night it quit working, started beeping after I'd gone to bed, and flashing number codes on the screen. It won't turn off now even when cancel button is pushed, I have to leave the door open or it continues to try to run while making a beeping alarm sound, I have to pull it out from the counter to unplug it from the back. I looked online and the codes have something to do with incoming water and/or drainage, but as far as I can tell there's no external issue and seeing how this is less than a year old and already giving me issues, I will lug it back into Costco and search again for a replacement. All of them nowadays seem to have bad reviews, so I'm not sure what to replace it with. I miss having confidence in making a large purchase. It's a crappy feeling to know I'm spending my money on a mediocre product that I know will not last more than a few years. Seriously considering not replacing and going back to hand washing.

Sentence (English): I had high hopes for ordering my first Bosch dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Ok Dishwasher ] || ---------------- || I had high hopes for ordering my first Bosch dishwasher. I've had it for a month now, and it's just ok. For about two weeks, my dishes would not dry on normal cycle, nor would they dry with adding the "Crystal Dry" option that adds more dry time. Bosch customer service helped me troubleshoot and extend the drying time for the normal cycle in settings - with that adjustment and using the Crystal Dry option, they get mostly dry. However, the inside of the dishwasher is still covered in a LOT of condensation after every load. This dishwasher does not have a heating element and uses Bosch's zeolite crystals in order to dry dishes. After about ten loads, and adding more time, that system started working well enough to get the dishes mostly dry. However, with all of the condensation on the walls of the interior, the inside of the dishwasher is always wet. It's not easy to prop the door open a little to let it air dry, so I'm left with leaving the door all the way open, in a high-traffic area of my kitchen, in order for the inside to dry. I was told to use RinseAid, but I think it's just silly to buy another product just so my dishes will dry. After three weeks of use, I spoke to customer service, in person, at Costco, and was told that I could return the dishwasher, but that I would have to uninstall it and transport it to Costco myself. Quite frankly, it's not worth the hassle. The tines for the plates are incredibly close together - this is great for being able to load a lot of plates, but if you have thick plates, they likely won't fit. The middle rack (for glassware, etc) is also a bit odd in its configuration. Pros of this dishwasher: it's incredibly quiet and it gets the dishes clean.

Sentence (English): Positives are; It is a very quiet machine.
Comments (English): [ Help for others and Café ] || ---------------- || Positives are; It is a very quiet machine. The dishes are clean and glasses sparkle, with rinse aid. The front display is very helpful, and also discrete enough it doesn't distract from the beauty of my kitchen. I only knock one star because the racks do not slide perfectly. If it was on a machine that was not as well done in every other way I probably would have not noticed. I also only give it 4 stars because of the generic responses Café gives. Probably too many responses to give, to give proper advice. Thinking I will give some instead, that the install manual clearly states. 1st the door flop is because the machine is a built in, and adjustable to different weight doors. You need to set the tension springs to the weight of the door. Refer to installation manual. 2nd the door sensor, there are 4 plastic tabs/plugs that come uninstalled. There are only 2 holes to instal them, so only one pair fits the machine you have. This is listed on a separate piece of paper not in the instillation guide, easily overlooked by installers. Find the right pair for your machine, there are 2 little holes just inside where the door shuts. Install these tabs/plugs in the holes. They need to be there to keep the door properly shut.3rd is; If you are using pods make sure it doesn't put pressure on the detergent release when you close it. This can lead to the door not opening. The machine can leave some residue in the detergent cup, but I have found this is pretty normal for most machines, and in no way effects the the dishes. The last very very nit picky thing is… I did DBA test and is it 39 DBA? Do not get me wrong it is very very quiet! The difference between 43 and 39 Dba is not even an audible Difference. Mine is installed in a kitchen island. I understand the walls of the kitchen island are none insulated, and not built to the thickness a kitchen wall would be. That being said I can't be the only one with a dishwasher installed this way, and I feel that makes it a little louder than 39DBA. HahaIt's a wonderful machine so far, I love the looks. I think it was very well thought out machine. I really have 0 complaints that a normal person should find other than the slide of the racks. Think a lot of complaints, are user error, or could be solved with making sure installation was done properly

Sentence (English): After a week of use, many people in the product reviews fill the lower water tank.
Comments (English): [ Device optimized for narrow spaces ] || ---------------- || After a week of use, many people in the product reviews fill the lower water tank. However, since the faucet doesn't reach the water supply area, it's inconvenient to pour water every time. So, I purchased a 5-liter beaker from Coupang and placed it behind the machine, connecting it to the water supply line. The standard cycle uses 5.2 liters of water per cycle, but the beaker holds more than 5 liters, so I only need to fill it once before using it. Despite its small size, the cleaning power is decent. Since the dedicated detergent is expensive, I use a different liquid detergent. The upper shelf can be easily placed on top of the Hidan shelf or removed. The lower main shelf is also not fixed to the machine and can be easily removed. The interior of the machine is made of plastic. When cold water is supplied, the water is heated internally, and the machine washes with hot water. Once the washing is complete, the drying process begins. The door automatically opens slightly, about 1 cm, to release steam. The door then closes again, and the fan runs to complete the drying process. However, moisture still remains even after the machine is fully dry. My kitchen is small, so I gave up on the dishwasher until I discovered this product and installed it. Even though it has some shortcomings, I am grateful to see the machine running. I hate noise, but I can just sit at the table right next to the dishwasher and do my business, and it makes me happy. With dishwashers that go under the sink, I have to bend down to put dishes in and take them out, but this one doesn't have to do that. I highly recommend it to people with small kitchens. Installation is also easy. Just plug in the water supply and drain pipes. Because of the water purifier, one of the four corners of the machine is floating in the air due to the small space, but it still works.
Comments (Original): [ 좁은 공간에 최적화된 기기 ] || ---------------- || 일주일 사용 후기 상품평의 많은 분들께서 하부 물탱크에 물 채워 쓰시는데 저는 물 공급 부분에 수도꼭지가 닿지 않아 일일이 부어주기가 불편하여 쿠팡에서 5리터 비커를 구매해 기계 뒷편에 두고 급수관 꽂아서 사용하니 편리합니다. 표준코스 1회 물 사용량이 5.2리터인데 비커에 5리터보다 더 들어가서 작동 전 1회 물 공급으로 해결 가능. 작지만 세척력 나쁘지 않고요. 전용세제가 비싸서 다른  액체세제 사용합니다.  상단 선반은 히단선반 꼭대기에 쉽게 얹어 사용하거나 제거가 가능합니다. 아래 메인 선반도 기기에 고정돼있지 않고 쉽게 뺄 수 있어요. 세척기 내부 소재는 플라스틱입니다. 냉수를 공급해주면 안에서 물울 데워 뜨거운 물로 세척하고 세척 완료되면 건조 시작하면서 자동으로 문이 1센티 가량 아주 조금 열려 김이 빠지고 다시 문이 닫히고 팬이 돌아가며 건조를 마무리하는데 완전히 작동이 끝난 후에도 습기가 남아있긴 합니다. 좁은 주방이라 식세기 포기하고 살다가 이런 제품을 발견하고 설치한 터라 조금 부족한 점이 있어도 기계 돌아가는 걸 보면 고맙게만 느껴집니다. 시끄러운 거 싫어하는데 작동시키고 세척기 바로 옆 식탁에서 볼일 보며 앉아있어도 흐뭇하기만 합니다. 씽크대 아래로 들어가는 세척기는 그릇 넣고 뺄때 허리 숙여야 하는데 이건 안 그래서 좋고요. 주방 좁으신 분들에게 강추합니다. 설치도 어렵지 않아요. 급수관 배수관만 꽂으면 됩니다. 정수기 때문에 자리가 좁아서 기기 네 꼭짓점 중 한 군데는 공중에 붕 떠있는데도 작동하는 데 지장이 없습니다.

AND, I buy the super expensive dishwasher pods with the extra liquid detergent in it, and half the time after the cycle, the pod will be sitting in the bottom of the dishwasher, it didn't even dissolve! Don't bother buying this dishwasher, you'll just end up re-cleaning all your dishes by hand

Sentence (English): Siemens dishwashers are still very good.
Comments (English): Siemens dishwashers are still very good. This is already my second one. I have been using Siemens products for more than 10 years. When I used a Siemens refrigerator for the first time, my child played with the magnetic wand and it got into the door panel. The door could not be closed tightly. , and couldn't find the reason. Siemens Beijing staff came twice and couldn't find the reason. Then Siemens transferred an engineer from Hefei to remove the door panel, find the magnetic rod, and the door was closed. A story from more than 10 years ago. At that time, I checked the cost of a round-trip air ticket from Hefei to Beijing*. My refrigerator is only *block. I am very touched by Siemens' cost-effective service. In the future, most of the products will be made by Siemens, including hoods, stoves, integrated steamers and ovens, washing machines, two dishwashers, etc. Whether it was customer service or logistics, the installation was very good. If there were various problems during the installation process, Siemens installation personnel helped to solve them. Thank you!

Sentence (English): This dishwasher cleans dishes very well.
Comments (English): [ Excellent Cleaning, Poor Racks ] || ---------------- || This dishwasher cleans dishes very well. I have no regrets there! My main gripe is how poorly the racks fits dishes. I don't mind playing tetris with casserole dishes or mixing bowls, but day-to-day dishes are a pain. There are 7 slots of reasonably-sized tines on top for bowls, and a decent amount on the bottom for plates (but they won't fit bowls). Unfortunately, the silveware rack takes up a third of the "good" plate spaces and won't fit on the narrow tines! The rest of the tines are so close together that I can only fit Corelle-style plates/saucers in them. My stonewear bowls & plates just have to kind of lean awkwardly everywhere and take up a lot more space than they should since they don't fit the tines. And my half-sheet baking pans fit in one spot along the edge-- if I ignore how it catches the top rack, even though I've moved it up as far as it goes. I need an inch more clearance there to be happy. I also wish more functions were available without complex button procedures-- to avoid those, the app must be used. Overall I'm left with an impression of "it's fine, I guess" and not "Wow! " so it's 3 stars instead of 4 or 5, despite the cleaning ability.

Sentence (English): Our Whirlpool diswasher was dripping by the heating coil and made huge mess soaking into the drywall.
Comments (English): [ Nice dishwasher, our first Bosch ] || ---------------- || Our Whirlpool diswasher was dripping by the heating coil and made huge mess soaking into the drywall. After doing some research, the Bosch 300 came out on the top of the list. The Bosch power and drain connections are all at the back, vs middle bottom of whirlpool. I mounted an electrical box under the sink with GFI and opened the hole for drain hose larger so I could slowly feed the drain pipe back under the sink when pushing the Bosch into place. I was surprised that the Bosch does not have a heating coil and uses condensation to help dry dishes. I think keeping the jet dry liquid filled is going to be a good idea. The default sensor cycle is 2 hours, 2.5 hours if you want to add sanitize. The top silverware drawer is interesting, it does help separate the silverware for better cleaning. Hopefully the Bosch lasts longer than the Whirpool.

Sentence (English): We looked for a suitable dishwasher for a long time and luckily ended up with this device.
Comments (English): [ Space saver and great overall package ] || ---------------- || We looked for a suitable dishwasher for a long time and luckily ended up with this device. What goes into this is crazy. With many other devices, no glass would have been able to stand upright in the upper basket if our plates were stored underneath. That's absolutely no problem here, there's enough space for everything and the upper basket can also be easily adjusted to 3 heights. The arrangement and use of the holders, some of which can be folded down, is also great for us and can be used very variably. We are particularly happy about a well-thought-out cutlery drawer where everything doesn't fall into each other and then not get clean. The cutlery is well fixed and there is still enough space for utensils such as spatulas, wooden spoons, etc. And: everything is spotlessly clean! Both the structure and the operation are well and clearly described. If you take a little time to read through everything, you will quickly become familiar with the device. And if you have a question, there is friendly and competent customer service, which, unlike some competitors, can also be reached by phone. Also very practical: the connection with the app. Here you can also get a lot of information, use it to set up and control the device, receive notifications when, for example, the rinse aid is empty or the washing program has ended and you can also control it on the go. The device can also be integrated into the SmartHome, in our case Google, which also gives us information and control options via our Smarthubs. Software updates for the dishwasher and other washing programs can also be downloaded via the app. The device can also be easily controlled and operated using the buttons and the display is clear and easy to read. In terms of operating noise, everything is within the normal range, but a quiet mode can also be switched on if necessary. When choosing the programs and options, no wishes are left unfulfilled, so that you can always find a combination that fits your respective requirements. We can fully recommend this dishwasher and are very happy with our new "roommate". This was definitely not our last Bosch device. Here you can still get sensible and well thought-out quality products and are still valued as a customer.
Comments (Original): [ Raumwunder und super Gesamtpaket ] || ---------------- || Wir haben lange nach einem geeigneten Geschirrspüler für uns gesucht und sind am Ende glücklicherweise bei diesem Gerät gelandet. Was hier alles reingeht ist schon Wahnsinn. Bei vielen anderen Geräten hätte im Oberkorb kein Glas mehr aufrecht stehen können, wenn darunter unsere Teller eingeräumt waren. Das ist hier absolut kein Problem, genug Platz für Alles und der Oberkorb lässt sich auch ganz einfach in 3 Höhen verstellen. Auch die Anordnung und Nutzung der z.T. umklappbaren Halter ist für uns Top und sehr variabel nutzbar.Besonders freuen wir uns über eine durchdachte Besteck-Schublade, bei der nicht alles ineinander fällt und dann nicht sauber wird. Das Besteck ist gut fixiert und dazu bleibt noch genug Platz für Utensilien, wie Pfannenwender, Kochlöffel etc. Und: Es wird alles tiptop sauber!Sowohl der Aufbau als auch die Bedienung sind gut und übersichtlich beschrieben. Wenn man sich ein wenig Zeit nimmt, um alles einmal durchzulesen, ist man schnell mit dem Gerät vertraut. Und wenn man eine Frage hat, gibt es einen freundlichen und kompetenten Kundenservice, der im Gegensatz zu manchem Mitbewerber auch telefonisch erreichbar ist.Auch total praktisch: Die Kopplung mit der App. Hier bekommt man auch noch viele Infos, kann das Gerät damit einrichten und steuern, erhält Benachrichtigungen, wenn z.B. der Klarspüler leer ist oder das Spülprogramm beendet wurde und auch die Steuerung von unterwegs ist möglich. Zudem lässt das Gerät sich auch ins SmartHome integrieren, in unserem Fall google, wodurch wir auch über unsere Smarthubs Info- und Steuerungsmöglichkeiten haben. Auch Softwareupdates für den Geschirrspüler und weitere Spül-Programme lassen sich über die App herunterladen.Das Gerät lässt sich aber auch problemlos über die Tasten steuern und bedienen und das Display ist übersichtlich und gut abzulesen.Vom Betriebsgeräusch her ist alles im normalen Bereich, bei Bedarf lässt sich aber auch ein Leise-Modus zuschalten. Bei der Wahl der Programme und Optionen bleiben keine Wünsche offen, so dass man immer eine Kombination findet, die auf die jeweiligen Anforderungen passt.Wir können diesen Geschirrspüler uneingeschränkt weiter empfehlen und sind sehr glücklich mit unserem neuen 'Mitbewohner'.Das war mit Sicherheit nicht unser letztes Bosch-Gerät. Hier bekommt man noch vernünftige und durchdachte Qualitäts-Produkte und wird als Kunde noch wertgeschätzt...

Das Besteck ist gut fixiert und dazu bleibt noch genug Platz für Utensilien, wie Pfannenwender, Kochlöffel etc. Und: Es wird alles tiptop sauber!Sowohl der Aufbau als auch die Bedienung sind gut und übersichtlich beschrieben. Wenn man sich ein wenig Zeit nimmt, um alles einmal durchzulesen, ist man schnell mit dem Gerät vertraut. Und wenn man eine Frage hat, gibt es einen freundlichen und kompetenten Kundenservice, der im Gegensatz zu manchem Mitbewerber auch telefonisch erreichbar ist.Auch total praktisch: Die Kopplung mit der App. Hier bekommt man auch noch viele Infos, kann das Gerät damit einrichten und steuern, erhält Benachrichtigungen, wenn z.B. der Klarspüler leer ist oder das Spülprogramm beendet wurde und auch die Steuerung von unterwegs ist möglich. Zudem lässt das Gerät sich auch ins SmartHome integrieren, in unserem Fall google, wodurch wir auch über unsere Smarthubs Info- und Steuerungsmöglichkeiten haben. Auch Softwareupdates für den Geschirrspüler und weitere Spül-Programme lassen sich über die App herunterladen.Das Gerät lässt sich aber auch problemlos über die Tasten steuern und bedienen und das Display ist übersichtlich und gut abzulesen.Vom Betriebsgeräusch her ist alles im normalen Bereich, bei Bedarf lässt sich aber auch ein Leise-Modus zuschalten. Bei der Wahl der Programme und Optionen bleiben keine Wünsche offen, so dass man immer eine Kombination findet, die auf die jeweiligen Anforderungen passt.Wir können diesen Geschirrspüler uneingeschränkt weiter empfehlen und sind sehr glücklich mit unserem neuen 'Mitbewohner'.Das war mit Sicherheit nicht unser letztes Bosch-Gerät. Hier bekommt man noch vernünftige und durchdachte Qualitäts-Produkte und wird als Kunde noch wertgeschätzt...

Sentence (English): I live with two children in elementary school.

Those who hesitated like me, definitely buy it! I highly recommend it!

I was wondering how to do it because it was a low-cost installation, but it turned out that I could just put it anywhere where the drain hose reaches the water drain. It's ambiguous to even think about installation. I've only used commercial dishwashers while working part-time, so this is my first time using a home dishwasher. When I saw that it took about an hour, I thought, "Wow, if it takes this long, I can just do it myself." But when I actually cook, wash the dishes, and clean up, it's so annoying. Now that I've put this back on and cleaned up, I can definitely feel how convenient it is to have one. I'm going to write a review of what I felt after using it for about ten days. Convenience First of all, there's no installation required. Just put it near the drain. I put it on the sink counter, and it's close to the water hose, so if I extend the hose, I can get water. I tried to get water and fill it, but because of the speed of the water flowing in, the water overflowed and it was inconvenient, so it was much easier to fill it directly with a hose. How to choose dishwasher detergent and the difference in cleaning power depending on the detergent It was my first time using a dishwasher, so I was worried about which detergent to buy, and when I looked it up, there were many types, such as liquid, powder, solid, and tube. I searched on YouTube, and since the cleaning power was good in solid form, I chose the solid form. I watched a video of a blind test of dishwasher detergent and chose the one I liked, and I put it on top of the dishwasher and used it one by one whenever I needed it, and it was very convenient. When you put it in the detergent compartment and close the lid, it falls to the floor by itself, so at first I wondered if this was right, but it was right. It seems to be the same as not putting it in the detergent compartment and throwing it on the floor from the beginning and using it. They say that the cleaning power and the amount of water left on the dishes can vary greatly depending on the detergent you use. I watched YouTube and bought xxpong solid detergent, and it was completely cleaned without any detergent residue. The glass bowl was covered in sesame oil while wrapping kimbap, but I didn't wash it because it was annoying, so I just threw it in and spun it, and it shines so much (photo attached). Isn't it amazing? And it says that if you use a detergent that includes dishwasher rinse or use a separate rinse, there will be less residue left on the dishes, but according to the reviews, some people say that the dishes are still wet. I think it's not a dishwasher problem, but a detergent problem, so I recommend that you change the detergent. Noise It feels like the noise of a microwave? I use it in the kitchen, and it's not annoying if you're in the room. Size It's as wide as a regular microwave, and it's about 1.5 times as tall as a microwave^^ How much can it hold? Is it really usable for 3 people? It says it's for 3 people, but I don't think it'll hold all the rice bowls, plates, soup bowls, cups, etc. that 3 people ate. If I play Tetris, will it all fit? Anyway, to eat, there are more dishes to wash while preparing food in addition to the dishes I used, right? Cooking utensils, bowls used for seasoning, bowls for putting ingredients, etc. Considering all that, I think it’s too much for 3 people and it’s just right for 1-2 people. I live alone, but if I cook with all the cooking utensils, knives, small bowls, used plates, spoons and forks, water cups, etc., the dishwasher is almost full. If 2 people use it here, they will add 1 cup, spoon and fork, and plate each, so I think it can be used by 2 people. Other things I like First of all, the design is pretty. The white and black combination is simple and modern, so it looks luxurious without any incongruity in the kitchen. I’m very satisfied because I can do other cleanup while the dishwasher is washing the dishes, which reduces the fatigue from housework. The suction cup that came with the drain hose fixing tip in the picture was too flimsy and didn’t absorb well, so the drain hose wasn’t fixed properly. So I used Daiso's 'One Touch Moa Clip' and fixed it to the corner of the sink^^ This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free as part of a Coupang Experience Group event.

I was wondering how to do it because it was a low-cost installation, but it turned out that I could just put it anywhere where the drain hose reaches the water drain. It's ambiguous to even think about installation. I've only used commercial dishwashers while working part-time, so this is my first time using a home dishwasher. When I saw that it took about an hour, I thought, "Wow, if it takes this long, I can just do it myself." But when I actually cook, wash the dishes, and clean up, it's so annoying. Now that I've put this back on and cleaned up, I can definitely feel how convenient it is to have one. I'm going to write a review of what I felt after using it for about ten days. Convenience First of all, there's no installation required. Just put it near the drain. I put it on the sink counter, and it's close to the water hose, so if I extend the hose, I can get water. I tried to get water and fill it, but because of the speed of the water flowing in, the water overflowed and it was inconvenient, so it was much easier to fill it directly with a hose. How to choose dishwasher detergent and the difference in cleaning power depending on the detergent It was my first time using a dishwasher, so I was worried about which detergent to buy, and when I looked it up, there were many types, such as liquid, powder, solid, and tube. I searched on YouTube, and since the cleaning power was good in solid form, I chose the solid form. I watched a video of a blind test of dishwasher detergent and chose the one I liked, and I put it on top of the dishwasher and used it one by one whenever I needed it, and it was very convenient. When you put it in the detergent compartment and close the lid, it falls to the floor by itself, so at first I wondered if this was right, but it was right. It seems to be the same as not putting it in the detergent compartment and throwing it on the floor from the beginning and using it. They say that the cleaning power and the amount of water left on the dishes can vary greatly depending on the detergent you use. I watched YouTube and bought xxpong solid detergent, and it was completely cleaned without any detergent residue. The glass bowl was covered in sesame oil while wrapping kimbap, but I didn't wash it because it was annoying, so I just threw it in and spun it, and it shines so much (photo attached). Isn't it amazing? And it says that if you use a detergent that includes dishwasher rinse or use a separate rinse, there will be less residue left on the dishes, but according to the reviews, some people say that the dishes are still wet. I think it's not a dishwasher problem, but a detergent problem, so I recommend that you change the detergent. Noise It feels like the noise of a microwave? I use it in the kitchen, and it's not annoying if you're in the room. Size It's as wide as a regular microwave, and it's about 1.5 times as tall as a microwave^^ How much can it hold? Is it really usable for 3 people? It says it's for 3 people, but I don't think it'll hold all the rice bowls, plates, soup bowls, cups, etc. that 3 people ate. If I play Tetris, will it all fit? Anyway, to eat, there are more dishes to wash while preparing food in addition to the dishes I used, right? Cooking utensils, bowls used for seasoning, bowls for putting ingredients, etc. Considering all that, I think it’s too much for 3 people and it’s just right for 1-2 people. I live alone, but if I cook with all the cooking utensils, knives, small bowls, used plates, spoons and forks, water cups, etc., the dishwasher is almost full. If 2 people use it here, they will add 1 cup, spoon and fork, and plate each, so I think it can be used by 2 people. Other things I like First of all, the design is pretty. The white and black combination is simple and modern, so it looks luxurious without any incongruity in the kitchen. I’m very satisfied because I can do other cleanup while the dishwasher is washing the dishes, which reduces the fatigue from housework. The suction cup that came with the drain hose fixing tip in the picture was too flimsy and didn’t absorb well, so the drain hose wasn’t fixed properly. So I used Daiso's 'One Touch Moa Clip' and fixed it to the corner of the sink^^ This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free as part of a Coupang Experience Group event.

How to choose dishwasher detergent and the difference in cleaning power depending on the detergent It was my first time using a dishwasher, so I was worried about which detergent to buy, and when I looked it up, there were many types, such as liquid, powder, solid, and tube. I searched on YouTube, and since the cleaning power was good in solid form, I chose the solid form. I watched a video of a blind test of dishwasher detergent and chose the one I liked, and I put it on top of the dishwasher and used it one by one whenever I needed it, and it was very convenient. When you put it in the detergent compartment and close the lid, it falls to the floor by itself, so at first I wondered if this was right, but it was right. It seems to be the same as not putting it in the detergent compartment and throwing it on the floor from the beginning and using it. They say that the cleaning power and the amount of water left on the dishes can vary greatly depending on the detergent you use. I watched YouTube and bought xxpong solid detergent, and it was completely cleaned without any detergent residue. The glass bowl was covered in sesame oil while wrapping kimbap, but I didn't wash it because it was annoying, so I just threw it in and spun it, and it shines so much (photo attached). Isn't it amazing? And it says that if you use a detergent that includes dishwasher rinse or use a separate rinse, there will be less residue left on the dishes, but according to the reviews, some people say that the dishes are still wet. I think it's not a dishwasher problem, but a detergent problem, so I recommend that you change the detergent. Noise It feels like the noise of a microwave? I use it in the kitchen, and it's not annoying if you're in the room. Size It's as wide as a regular microwave, and it's about 1.5 times as tall as a microwave^^ How much can it hold? Is it really usable for 3 people? It says it's for 3 people, but I don't think it'll hold all the rice bowls, plates, soup bowls, cups, etc. that 3 people ate. If I play Tetris, will it all fit? Anyway, to eat, there are more dishes to wash while preparing food in addition to the dishes I used, right? Cooking utensils, bowls used for seasoning, bowls for putting ingredients, etc. Considering all that, I think it’s too much for 3 people and it’s just right for 1-2 people. I live alone, but if I cook with all the cooking utensils, knives, small bowls, used plates, spoons and forks, water cups, etc., the dishwasher is almost full. If 2 people use it here, they will add 1 cup, spoon and fork, and plate each, so I think it can be used by 2 people. Other things I like First of all, the design is pretty. The white and black combination is simple and modern, so it looks luxurious without any incongruity in the kitchen. I’m very satisfied because I can do other cleanup while the dishwasher is washing the dishes, which reduces the fatigue from housework. Comments (English): [ Even if you just spin it without rinsing it with water, the cleaning power is amazing. ] || ---------------- || I always thought it would be nice to have a dishwasher, but I couldn't even think about buying one because I live alone. I finally got to try it out as a member of the experience group! I was wondering how to do it because it was a low-cost installation, but it turned out that I could just put it anywhere where the drain hose reaches the water drain. It's ambiguous to even think about installation. I've only used commercial dishwashers while working part-time, so this is my first time using a home dishwasher. When I saw that it took about an hour, I thought, "Wow, if it takes this long, I can just do it myself." But when I actually cook, wash the dishes, and clean up, it's so annoying. Now that I've put this back on and cleaned up, I can definitely feel how convenient it is to have one. I'm going to write a review of what I felt after using it for about ten days. Convenience First of all, there's no installation required. Just put it near the drain. I put it on the sink counter, and it's close to the water hose, so if I extend the hose, I can get water. I tried to get water and fill it, but because of the speed of the water flowing in, the water overflowed and it was inconvenient, so it was much easier to fill it directly with a hose. How to choose dishwasher detergent and the difference in cleaning power depending on the detergent It was my first time using a dishwasher, so I was worried about which detergent to buy, and when I looked it up, there were many types, such as liquid, powder, solid, and tube. I searched on YouTube, and since the cleaning power was good in solid form, I chose the solid form. I watched a video of a blind test of dishwasher detergent and chose the one I liked, and I put it on top of the dishwasher and used it one by one whenever I needed it, and it was very convenient. When you put it in the detergent compartment and close the lid, it falls to the floor by itself, so at first I wondered if this was right, but it was right. It seems to be the same as not putting it in the detergent compartment and throwing it on the floor from the beginning and using it. They say that the cleaning power and the amount of water left on the dishes can vary greatly depending on the detergent you use. I watched YouTube and bought xxpong solid detergent, and it was completely cleaned without any detergent residue. The glass bowl was covered in sesame oil while wrapping kimbap, but I didn't wash it because it was annoying, so I just threw it in and spun it, and it shines so much (photo attached). Isn't it amazing? And it says that if you use a detergent that includes dishwasher rinse or use a separate rinse, there will be less residue left on the dishes, but according to the reviews, some people say that the dishes are still wet. I think it's not a dishwasher problem, but a detergent problem, so I recommend that you change the detergent. Noise It feels like the noise of a microwave? I use it in the kitchen, and it's not annoying if you're in the room. Size It's as wide as a regular microwave, and it's about 1.5 times as tall as a microwave^^ How much can it hold? Is it really usable for 3 people? It says it's for 3 people, but I don't think it'll hold all the rice bowls, plates, soup bowls, cups, etc. that 3 people ate. If I play Tetris, will it all fit? Anyway, to eat, there are more dishes to wash while preparing food in addition to the dishes I used, right? Cooking utensils, bowls used for seasoning, bowls for putting ingredients, etc. Considering all that, I think it’s too much for 3 people and it’s just right for 1-2 people. I live alone, but if I cook with all the cooking utensils, knives, small bowls, used plates, spoons and forks, water cups, etc., the dishwasher is almost full. If 2 people use it here, they will add 1 cup, spoon and fork, and plate each, so I think it can be used by 2 people. Other things I like First of all, the design is pretty. The white and black combination is simple and modern, so it looks luxurious without any incongruity in the kitchen. I’m very satisfied because I can do other cleanup while the dishwasher is washing the dishes, which reduces the fatigue from housework. The suction cup that came with the drain hose fixing tip in the picture was too flimsy and didn’t absorb well, so the drain hose wasn’t fixed properly. So I used Daiso's 'One Touch Moa Clip' and fixed it to the corner of the sink^^ This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free as part of a Coupang Experience Group event.

I finally got to try it out as a member of the experience group! I was wondering how to do it because it was a low-cost installation, but it turned out that I could just put it anywhere where the drain hose reaches the water drain. It's ambiguous to even think about installation. I've only used commercial dishwashers while working part-time, so this is my first time using a home dishwasher. When I saw that it took about an hour, I thought, "Wow, if it takes this long, I can just do it myself." But when I actually cook, wash the dishes, and clean up, it's so annoying. Now that I've put this back on and cleaned up, I can definitely feel how convenient it is to have one. I'm going to write a review of what I felt after using it for about ten days. Convenience First of all, there's no installation required. Just put it near the drain. I put it on the sink counter, and it's close to the water hose, so if I extend the hose, I can get water. I tried to get water and fill it, but because of the speed of the water flowing in, the water overflowed and it was inconvenient, so it was much easier to fill it directly with a hose. How to choose dishwasher detergent and the difference in cleaning power depending on the detergent It was my first time using a dishwasher, so I was worried about which detergent to buy, and when I looked it up, there were many types, such as liquid, powder, solid, and tube. I searched on YouTube, and since the cleaning power was good in solid form, I chose the solid form. I watched a video of a blind test of dishwasher detergent and chose the one I liked, and I put it on top of the dishwasher and used it one by one whenever I needed it, and it was very convenient. When you put it in the detergent compartment and close the lid, it falls to the floor by itself, so at first I wondered if this was right, but it was right. It seems to be the same as not putting it in the detergent compartment and throwing it on the floor from the beginning and using it. They say that the cleaning power and the amount of water left on the dishes can vary greatly depending on the detergent you use. I watched YouTube and bought xxpong solid detergent, and it was completely cleaned without any detergent residue. The glass bowl was covered in sesame oil while wrapping kimbap, but I didn't wash it because it was annoying, so I just threw it in and spun it, and it shines so much (photo attached). Isn't it amazing? And it says that if you use a detergent that includes dishwasher rinse or use a separate rinse, there will be less residue left on the dishes, but according to the reviews, some people say that the dishes are still wet. I think it's not a dishwasher problem, but a detergent problem, so I recommend that you change the detergent. Noise It feels like the noise of a microwave? I use it in the kitchen, and it's not annoying if you're in the room. Size It's as wide as a regular microwave, and it's about 1.5 times as tall as a microwave^^ How much can it hold? Is it really usable for 3 people? It says it's for 3 people, but I don't think it'll hold all the rice bowls, plates, soup bowls, cups, etc. that 3 people ate. If I play Tetris, will it all fit? Anyway, to eat, there are more dishes to wash while preparing food in addition to the dishes I used, right? Cooking utensils, bowls used for seasoning, bowls for putting ingredients, etc. Considering all that, I think it’s too much for 3 people and it’s just right for 1-2 people. I live alone, but if I cook with all the cooking utensils, knives, small bowls, used plates, spoons and forks, water cups, etc., the dishwasher is almost full. If 2 people use it here, they will add 1 cup, spoon and fork, and plate each, so I think it can be used by 2 people. Other things I like First of all, the design is pretty. The white and black combination is simple and modern, so it looks luxurious without any incongruity in the kitchen. I’m very satisfied because I can do other cleanup while the dishwasher is washing the dishes, which reduces the fatigue from housework. The suction cup that came with the drain hose fixing tip in the picture was too flimsy and didn’t absorb well, so the drain hose wasn’t fixed properly. So I used Daiso's 'One Touch Moa Clip' and fixed it to the corner of the sink^^ This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free as part of a Coupang Experience Group event.

I was wondering how to do it because it was a low-cost installation, but it turned out that I could just put it anywhere where the drain hose reaches the water drain. It's ambiguous to even think about installation. I've only used commercial dishwashers while working part-time, so this is my first time using a home dishwasher. When I saw that it took about an hour, I thought, "Wow, if it takes this long, I can just do it myself." But when I actually cook, wash the dishes, and clean up, it's so annoying. Now that I've put this back on and cleaned up, I can definitely feel how convenient it is to have one. I'm going to write a review of what I felt after using it for about ten days. Convenience First of all, there's no installation required. Just put it near the drain. I put it on the sink counter, and it's close to the water hose, so if I extend the hose, I can get water. I tried to get water and fill it, but because of the speed of the water flowing in, the water overflowed and it was inconvenient, so it was much easier to fill it directly with a hose. How to choose dishwasher detergent and the difference in cleaning power depending on the detergent It was my first time using a dishwasher, so I was worried about which detergent to buy, and when I looked it up, there were many types, such as liquid, powder, solid, and tube. I searched on YouTube, and since the cleaning power was good in solid form, I chose the solid form. I watched a video of a blind test of dishwasher detergent and chose the one I liked, and I put it on top of the dishwasher and used it one by one whenever I needed it, and it was very convenient. When you put it in the detergent compartment and close the lid, it falls to the floor by itself, so at first I wondered if this was right, but it was right. It seems to be the same as not putting it in the detergent compartment and throwing it on the floor from the beginning and using it. They say that the cleaning power and the amount of water left on the dishes can vary greatly depending on the detergent you use. I watched YouTube and bought xxpong solid detergent, and it was completely cleaned without any detergent residue. The glass bowl was covered in sesame oil while wrapping kimbap, but I didn't wash it because it was annoying, so I just threw it in and spun it, and it shines so much (photo attached). Isn't it amazing? And it says that if you use a detergent that includes dishwasher rinse or use a separate rinse, there will be less residue left on the dishes, but according to the reviews, some people say that the dishes are still wet. I think it's not a dishwasher problem, but a detergent problem, so I recommend that you change the detergent. Noise It feels like the noise of a microwave? I use it in the kitchen, and it's not annoying if you're in the room. Size It's as wide as a regular microwave, and it's about 1.5 times as tall as a microwave^^ How much can it hold? Is it really usable for 3 people? It says it's for 3 people, but I don't think it'll hold all the rice bowls, plates, soup bowls, cups, etc. that 3 people ate. If I play Tetris, will it all fit? Anyway, to eat, there are more dishes to wash while preparing food in addition to the dishes I used, right? Cooking utensils, bowls used for seasoning, bowls for putting ingredients, etc. Considering all that, I think it’s too much for 3 people and it’s just right for 1-2 people. I live alone, but if I cook with all the cooking utensils, knives, small bowls, used plates, spoons and forks, water cups, etc., the dishwasher is almost full. If 2 people use it here, they will add 1 cup, spoon and fork, and plate each, so I think it can be used by 2 people. Other things I like First of all, the design is pretty. The white and black combination is simple and modern, so it looks luxurious without any incongruity in the kitchen. I’m very satisfied because I can do other cleanup while the dishwasher is washing the dishes, which reduces the fatigue from housework. The suction cup that came with the drain hose fixing tip in the picture was too flimsy and didn’t absorb well, so the drain hose wasn’t fixed properly. So I used Daiso's 'One Touch Moa Clip' and fixed it to the corner of the sink^^ This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free as part of a Coupang Experience Group event.

I was wondering how to do it because it was a low-cost installation, but it turned out that I could just put it anywhere where the drain hose reaches the water drain. It's ambiguous to even think about installation. I've only used commercial dishwashers while working part-time, so this is my first time using a home dishwasher. When I saw that it took about an hour, I thought, "Wow, if it takes this long, I can just do it myself." But when I actually cook, wash the dishes, and clean up, it's so annoying. Now that I've put this back on and cleaned up, I can definitely feel how convenient it is to have one. I'm going to write a review of what I felt after using it for about ten days. Convenience First of all, there's no installation required. Just put it near the drain. I put it on the sink counter, and it's close to the water hose, so if I extend the hose, I can get water. I tried to get water and fill it, but because of the speed of the water flowing in, the water overflowed and it was inconvenient, so it was much easier to fill it directly with a hose. How to choose dishwasher detergent and the difference in cleaning power depending on the detergent It was my first time using a dishwasher, so I was worried about which detergent to buy, and when I looked it up, there were many types, such as liquid, powder, solid, and tube. I searched on YouTube, and since the cleaning power was good in solid form, I chose the solid form. I watched a video of a blind test of dishwasher detergent and chose the one I liked, and I put it on top of the dishwasher and used it one by one whenever I needed it, and it was very convenient. When you put it in the detergent compartment and close the lid, it falls to the floor by itself, so at first I wondered if this was right, but it was right. It seems to be the same as not putting it in the detergent compartment and throwing it on the floor from the beginning and using it. They say that the cleaning power and the amount of water left on the dishes can vary greatly depending on the detergent you use. I watched YouTube and bought xxpong solid detergent, and it was completely cleaned without any detergent residue. The glass bowl was covered in sesame oil while wrapping kimbap, but I didn't wash it because it was annoying, so I just threw it in and spun it, and it shines so much (photo attached). Isn't it amazing? And it says that if you use a detergent that includes dishwasher rinse or use a separate rinse, there will be less residue left on the dishes, but according to the reviews, some people say that the dishes are still wet. I think it's not a dishwasher problem, but a detergent problem, so I recommend that you change the detergent. Noise It feels like the noise of a microwave? I use it in the kitchen, and it's not annoying if you're in the room. Size It's as wide as a regular microwave, and it's about 1.5 times as tall as a microwave^^ How much can it hold? Is it really usable for 3 people? It says it's for 3 people, but I don't think it'll hold all the rice bowls, plates, soup bowls, cups, etc. that 3 people ate. If I play Tetris, will it all fit? Anyway, to eat, there are more dishes to wash while preparing food in addition to the dishes I used, right? Cooking utensils, bowls used for seasoning, bowls for putting ingredients, etc. Considering all that, I think it’s too much for 3 people and it’s just right for 1-2 people. I live alone, but if I cook with all the cooking utensils, knives, small bowls, used plates, spoons and forks, water cups, etc., the dishwasher is almost full. If 2 people use it here, they will add 1 cup, spoon and fork, and plate each, so I think it can be used by 2 people. Other things I like First of all, the design is pretty. The white and black combination is simple and modern, so it looks luxurious without any incongruity in the kitchen. I’m very satisfied because I can do other cleanup while the dishwasher is washing the dishes, which reduces the fatigue from housework. The suction cup that came with the drain hose fixing tip in the picture was too flimsy and didn’t absorb well, so the drain hose wasn’t fixed properly. So I used Daiso's 'One Touch Moa Clip' and fixed it to the corner of the sink^^ This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free as part of a Coupang Experience Group event.

I was wondering how to do it because it was a low-cost installation, but it turned out that I could just put it anywhere where the drain hose reaches the water drain. It's ambiguous to even think about installation. I've only used commercial dishwashers while working part-time, so this is my first time using a home dishwasher. When I saw that it took about an hour, I thought, "Wow, if it takes this long, I can just do it myself." But when I actually cook, wash the dishes, and clean up, it's so annoying. Now that I've put this back on and cleaned up, I can definitely feel how convenient it is to have one. I'm going to write a review of what I felt after using it for about ten days. Convenience First of all, there's no installation required. Just put it near the drain. I put it on the sink counter, and it's close to the water hose, so if I extend the hose, I can get water. I tried to get water and fill it, but because of the speed of the water flowing in, the water overflowed and it was inconvenient, so it was much easier to fill it directly with a hose. How to choose dishwasher detergent and the difference in cleaning power depending on the detergent It was my first time using a dishwasher, so I was worried about which detergent to buy, and when I looked it up, there were many types, such as liquid, powder, solid, and tube. I searched on YouTube, and since the cleaning power was good in solid form, I chose the solid form. I watched a video of a blind test of dishwasher detergent and chose the one I liked, and I put it on top of the dishwasher and used it one by one whenever I needed it, and it was very convenient. When you put it in the detergent compartment and close the lid, it falls to the floor by itself, so at first I wondered if this was right, but it was right. It seems to be the same as not putting it in the detergent compartment and throwing it on the floor from the beginning and using it. They say that the cleaning power and the amount of water left on the dishes can vary greatly depending on the detergent you use. I watched YouTube and bought xxpong solid detergent, and it was completely cleaned without any detergent residue. The glass bowl was covered in sesame oil while wrapping kimbap, but I didn't wash it because it was annoying, so I just threw it in and spun it, and it shines so much (photo attached). Isn't it amazing? And it says that if you use a detergent that includes dishwasher rinse or use a separate rinse, there will be less residue left on the dishes, but according to the reviews, some people say that the dishes are still wet. I think it's not a dishwasher problem, but a detergent problem, so I recommend that you change the detergent. Noise It feels like the noise of a microwave? I use it in the kitchen, and it's not annoying if you're in the room. Size It's as wide as a regular microwave, and it's about 1.5 times as tall as a microwave^^ How much can it hold? Is it really usable for 3 people? It says it's for 3 people, but I don't think it'll hold all the rice bowls, plates, soup bowls, cups, etc. that 3 people ate. If I play Tetris, will it all fit? Anyway, to eat, there are more dishes to wash while preparing food in addition to the dishes I used, right? Cooking utensils, bowls used for seasoning, bowls for putting ingredients, etc. Considering all that, I think it’s too much for 3 people and it’s just right for 1-2 people. I live alone, but if I cook with all the cooking utensils, knives, small bowls, used plates, spoons and forks, water cups, etc., the dishwasher is almost full. If 2 people use it here, they will add 1 cup, spoon and fork, and plate each, so I think it can be used by 2 people. Other things I like First of all, the design is pretty. The white and black combination is simple and modern, so it looks luxurious without any incongruity in the kitchen. I’m very satisfied because I can do other cleanup while the dishwasher is washing the dishes, which reduces the fatigue from housework. The suction cup that came with the drain hose fixing tip in the picture was too flimsy and didn’t absorb well, so the drain hose wasn’t fixed properly. So I used Daiso's 'One Touch Moa Clip' and fixed it to the corner of the sink^^ This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free as part of a Coupang Experience Group event.

Sentence (English): I am a working parent with a second-grade child.
Comments (English): I am a working parent with a second-grade child. I didn't buy one when we moved in because I thought I could just quickly do the dishes myself and didn't really need one. But seriously, I regretted it. Hesitation only delays delivery! It’s really hectic getting home from work, doing laundry, helping the kids with homework, and tidying up. Especially when I’m doing the dishes, the kids call out to me from both sides, and I have to take off and put on my rubber gloves. But now that I run the dishwasher, I have time left over so I can do housework leisurely, and I can gather with the kids to study together or play board games! I was planning on getting a built-in model, but I couldn't give up space, so I went up to the 6-person capacity version. I was surprised by how big it was, but I like that even the frying pan I used to grill pork belly fits inside. The automatic opening feature is especially great. Even if I start it and leave for work, the door stays open when it finishes, so the dishes are nice and dry when I get home. Before, when it rained or it was humid, the dishes wouldn't dry completely, so I had to hang them everywhere to dry before organizing, but now I can keep everything neatly organized. If you hesitated like me, you absolutely must buy this! I highly recommend it!

Sentence (English): We purchased this unit because it was almost the same as a KitchenAid in appearance and function.
Comments (English): [ Super Quiet - Large Capacity ] || ---------------- || We purchased this unit because it was almost the same as a KitchenAid in appearance and functionality. Definitely like how quiet it is and how much it holds. I've only done two complete loads since it was installed almost 2 weeks ago. The run time is long, but that doesn't bother us at all, as we use the delay start to run at night when our electricity rates are cheaper anyways. I can easily see the control panel while in use and I really like that it tells me when the dishes are clean as my wife use to ask me that question with our old machine that did not tell you it was done, complete or clean. We are still getting use to how far the door opens towards the floor but that really is not an issue. We did have some plastic on the second rack that did not completely dry on the extended dry setting, but the plastic has lips on them that catch water. Our old drawer dishwasher did not completely dry the plastic either. Overall, we are happy with this dishwasher and the cost of this dishwasher was much better than most dishwashers with very similar features and looks.

He lacked a part that he said I should have had to connect the dishwasher to the sink drain. He miraculously came up with something out of his truck. The dishwasher does a good job on cleaning, but simply doesn't dry. It gets steamy in the SS cabinet, but the dishes and interior cabinet are more than just damp - they are wet, wet, wet. A major drying session is necessary before they can be put away. I have to dry the entire cabinet before I can close it up because I am afraid of mold growing and ruining the gaskets, etc. So I have a call in to Costco, who is sending someone tomorrow to 'check the installation', but they will neither re-install nor repair if needed. I feel like I'm out of pocket $1300 on this machine.

Sentence (English): Overall this is a good dishwasher however there are a few components that I find disappointing.
Comments (English): [ Almost There ] || ---------------- || Overall this is a good dishwasher however there are a few components that I find disappointing. 1. The 3rd drawer is almost useless. I was very excited about this feature and used it as a factor for this purchase. The height between the top of the dishwasher and the drawer is so shallow that you are extremely limited in what you can put in there and still be able to close the drawer. 2. 3rd drawer does not have spray nozels dedicated to this drawer. This means it only gets water that can get around what you have in the top rack. You have to be careful you don't have big bowls blocking the 3rd tray. 3. Half Load Feature. Like the 3rd drawer this was a feature I specifically looked for. The documentation on this was extremely limited. Ony after making the purchase did I email support to get clarification . big mistake as this would have changed my mind on the unit. My last dishwasher had a half load feature I really liked. When selected the dishwasher would wash only the top rack (which was adjustable to provide enough room as is available on the lower rack). In this make/model, half load only tells the unit you only filled it up half way. Not fully sure of the value in that since it still sends water to both the top and bottom. 4. Several features (like the most important of all - the crystal dry feature) is only available for selection from within the app you need to download and install on your phone. All features should be available from the main control panel and not require an app to choose. Does this do a good job of cleaning? Yes. Is it quite (like advertised)? Absolutely. It is the quietest dishwasher I almost don't hear. When running, it sounds like a very light rainfall outside. Definitely does not sound like a dishwasher. If I had to choose again now that I have experience with this make/model would I make the same decision? Not sure. I definitely would be looking closer at my other options.

Sentence (English): #Participating in Samsung Electronics Event #No need to worry about washing dishes!
Comments (English): [ #Participating in Samsung Electronics Event #No need to worry about washing dishes! I live alone and I wash dishes rather than clean. ] || ---------------- || #Participating in Samsung Electronics Event #No need to worry about washing dishes! I live alone and hate washing dishes more than cleaning, so I thought about it before buying it. I am satisfied with both the size, performance and design. Look at the sink faucet installation details before purchasing. Is this possible because my house has a drum washing machine installed? I was worried. Since it is a small house, the washing machine and dishwasher are all connected to the sink faucet! (I informed you in advance by phone before visiting). On the day of installation, I couldn't use it because I didn't have detergent, but the technician showed me how to use it for a test run. I wanted to use it quickly, so I bought German dishwasher detergent from Baedal Minjok for all of us! It was my first time putting a bowl in it, so I used it with strong/strong drying, and this is a photo review. It's clean without any water marks~ :) . The second use is using standard/strong drying. Since I have less than 20 dishes on average, I divide up the detergent and store it in small zipper packs. (The amount of detergent used is clearly explained in the coupon book). I collect it for about a day and use it, and on days when the amount of dishes is small, I save it for up to two days. Instead, I cleaned up some of the debris and placed it in the sink, so it didn't smell or feel uncomfortable. This is my first time using a dishwasher, so I haven't found any shortcomings yet. I have used it 5-6 times for 3 weeks now, and I will leave a review after using it for a few months^^. As a 10th anniversary purchase benefit, I purchased it together with an oven and received up to 200,000 won points. I'm so glad I purchased a product that is cost-effective and performs well :)

Sentence (English): Our first dishwasher was a portable roll-around which we connected to our sink faucet.
Comments (English): [ A major improvement over our previous dishwashers! ] || ---------------- || Our first dishwasher was a portable roll-around which we connected to our sink faucet. It simply washed, without any abilities to adjust.Or second came with our new home in 1985. It worked ok, but had to be replaced, due to a slow leak which we knew would only get worse.Our third was another brand which worked ok, but we always had to rinse everything first. It got so bad, with 2 hour washes that didn't get things clean, that we finally decided to listen to the reviews and purchase a Bosch. So far, we have been very pleased, especially with the stainless steel interior and 3rd rack. A negative in some reviews was that the 300 did not dry plastic items well, but it has done a better job than any of our previous dishwashers. If this turns out to be the only major negative, then we are very pleased.We only searched for energy star products when we replaced our previous dishwasher. The 300 easily meets that efficiency standard.The controls are straightforward and work well.We only use liquid/gel soap, no packets at all.This is a VERY quiet dishwasher.Everything has come out very clean, even items which we have not rinsed.The silverware tray actually has openings which fit all our items. Our previous dishwashers did not, and I had to enlarge some of the slots. Thankfully, that is not necessary with the 300.One negative, which can be handled, is how close the rack tines are. They do not allow some of our dish plates to fit, so we just move to the next slot, ignoring one set of tines.Installation issues.We purchased via Costco, which included free installation. Unfortunately, our previous dishwashers were hard wired, so we had to pay for installing a 120V outlet.Also, the Bosch 300 did not include a new overflow outlet, so we had to use the old one.

It is probably because the Media dishwasher's high-pressure rotary spray system sprays strong water streams from the upper and lower pumps! I am very satisfied. 2. There is no peculiar smell. The reasons I didn't use a dishwasher until now are because it was an expensive home appliance, it didn't clean cleanly, and I put it off because I heard that it had a peculiar smell when put in the dishwasher. However, there is a dishwasher that breaks all my stereotypes, and it is the Media dishwasher! I will introduce its advantages! 1. Powerful cleaning power The most important thing about a dishwasher is how well it cleans and whether there are any residues, but you really don't have to worry. It cleans so well. When I first used the dishwasher, I used it after wiping off almost all the stains with a larva, and now I just roughly wipe it and put it in the dishwasher. It is clean before and after regardless of whether I wipe it with a larva or not! It is probably because the Media dishwasher's high-pressure rotary spray system sprays strong water streams from the upper and lower pumps! I am very satisfied. 2. There is no peculiar smell. In the past, the dishes in the house where the dishwasher was used smelled, but there is no smell with the Media dishwasher! It is washed with high temperature water of 72 degrees, so the only smell is the fragrant detergent scent. 3. Various washing modes It is good that you can set the washing mode depending on the food you ate that day and the condition of the dishes. There are a total of 5 functions: 1. Standard wash 2. Then you can use super clean dishes that are as clean as new dishes. 4. Easy installation, pretty design Even women can easily assemble it! The fact that it is a no-touch system makes it easy and simple to install even if you don't live in your own home is a big advantage. When my husband was away, I installed it by myself in less than 10 minutes. Now, there's only one disadvantage. Since the dishwasher is small for 3 people, large dishes don't fit. Since it's a 3-person dishwasher, it's small, so large frying pans or dishes don't fit. So I wash large dishes separately, but compared to before, the amount of dishwashing has been reduced by half, so it's not that inconvenient. I want to recommend it to people who don't live in their own homes, newlyweds, people living alone, and mothers raising children. When you raise children, you really have to keep washing bottles, especially newborns, because they use a lot. Take care of your baby, wash bottles, and repeat every day! One dishwasher can change your quality of life. And people who don't like washing dishes and people living alone can feel 100% satisfied if they use it! Sentence (English): After two years of use I think I can post an accurate review of the product.
Comments (English): [ Range/oven work great but a couple of issues. ] || ---------------- || After two years of use I think I can post an accurate review of the product. Overall we are happy with the performance with just a couple of issues which I will address at the endThe good: nice looking stove, was easy To install. All the cooking features work great. Love the air fry feature ( ours came with the fryer basket included). No more deep fried French fries and chicken wings! We use the convection feature a lot and really does a great job on pizza. The stove top is relatively easy to clean if you should spill liquids on it. The self clean feature for the oven works well. The bad: as with many other users the ease at which the control knobs turn on by accidentally bumping them is a serious concern. In two years this has happened three or four times. Luckily there has not been anything on the stovetop so there was no fire. The lock feature could be used to prevent this issue but really who remembers to lock the control after each and every cooking session. The designers need to come up with something better to prevent this from occurring. Additionally, the controls are not lit up so they are extremely hard to read. This is very annoying. If the ambient light in the kitchen is not extremely bright it is very hard to make out the dial readings and the control buttons for the oven features. If these two negative features could be resolved, I would be able to give this product 5 stars.

However, on the day of delivery the installers refused to install due to 'plastic value on the water line.' Costco told me I had to have a plumber come out to replace the part before they could install. I had two different companies out, both stated the change was not necessary and that my whole set up was just fine and to code. Upon hearing this I asked Costco to send a different installer out. They refused and offered to credit me to use a different installer. I then had 3 plumbing companies out and the cheapest was $800 to install. Reluctantly we paid the $800. Shortly after the installation was completed I received a phone call stating that Costco logistics was going to send out a different installer which would've been amazing if I wasn't already told there was no possibility of that happening. Costco then offered to credit us only $250 towards the $800 we paid to install. The dishwasher is great, but I would not recommend buying it from Costco if you're expecting a smooth process.

Sentence (English): Our first dishwasher was a portable roll-around which we connected to our sink faucet.
Comments (English): [ A major improvement over our previous dishwashers! ] || ---------------- || Our first dishwasher was a portable roll-around which we connected to our sink faucet. It simply washed, without any abilities to adjust. Or second came with our new home in 1985. It worked ok, but had to be replaced, due to a slow leak which we knew would only get worse. Our third was another brand which worked ok, but we always had to rinse everything first. It got so bad, with 2 hour washes that didn't get things clean, that we finally decided to listen to the reviews and purchase a Bosch. So far, we have been very pleased, especially with the stainless steel interior and 3rd rack. A negative in some reviews was that the 300 did not dry plastic items well, but it has done a better job than any of our previous dishwashers. If this turns out to be the only major negative, then we are very pleased. We only searched for energy star products when we replaced our previous dishwasher. The 300 easily meets that efficiency standard. The controls are straightforward and work well. We only use liquid/gel soap, no packets at all. This is a VERY quiet dishwasher. Everything has come out very clean, even items which we have not rinsed. The silverware tray actually has openings which fit all our items. Our previous dishwashers did not, and I had to enlarge some of the slots. Thankfully, that is not necessary with the 300. One negative, which can be handled, is how close the rack tines are. They do not allow some of our dish plates to fit, so we just move to the next slot, ignoring one set of tines. Installation issues. We purchased via Costco, which included free installation. Unfortunately, our previous dishwashers were hard wired, so we had to pay for installing a 120V outlet. Also, the Bosch 300 did not include a new overflow outlet, so we had to use the old one.

Sentence (English): While watching the LG ThingQ dishwasher usage video, I was really surprised by the ability to control all LG ThingQ electronic products through the app.
Comments (English): While watching the LG ThingQ dishwasher usage video, I was really surprised by the ability to control all LG ThingQ electronic products through the app. After installing each app and registering the product, it is surprising that you can conveniently operate the device at home from sitting or lying down without having to get up and down. You can check it while lying down without having to get up and go to check the air conditioner in your daughter's room while you sleep. If you register the refrigerator with the app through food scanning, it is immediately registered as an ingredient in the refrigerator, so you can check the condition of the refrigerator on the app, and check the status of the air conditioner and air purifier filters. I think it will be especially useful for housewives like me who work at home because it allows you to check through the app and connect to orders right away when necessary, so there is a lot less to worry about around the house. As I work from home, my days go by at a hectic pace due to a mix of housework and work, but I think my leisure time will be further upgraded through the convenient app control of LG ThingQ home appliances. The hot heat remains and the inside dishes are dried without moisture, but instead of leaving it on, I open the door to dry the moisture. Noise 9. Good, not irritating, and minimal. Design 9. Clean white. I've only used it once, so I'll have to use it more to know for sure, but I'm generally satisfied. This is my second review. When I opened the door, there was half a ton of detergent left, and the small dishes were washed well, but the large dishes were slippery. Thinking about it, I think there's a problem with the dishwasher display position. I think the pots that are larger than the bowls pressed down on the detergent cover, preventing the detergent from soaking in. When there are a lot of dishes, I think you should just throw the detergent in the middle instead of the detergent storage tray so that it can function as a detergent. I put the slippery large pots back in the weak wash cycle with the remaining detergent and ran it, and it was cleaned cleanly. Since I use it about once a day, I took out the dishwasher tray to remove moisture after using the machine, dried it, opened the door, wiped the moisture, and dried the inside. Since moisture is a natural source of bacteria, maintenance is important. This is a review after using it more than three times. I'm satisfied. It seems to be effective because I use it with a small amount of dishes. Just like washing dishes separately, I wash them by washing them separately, and I wash them by removing oily and greasy ones. It is effective if you separate small and large pots and use them appropriately. Of course, there is the problem of consumption because you have to run it multiple times, but I guess there is nothing you can do about it since there are cons where there are gains. After using it for several months, it is good for the price, but the capacity is a bit small so it is difficult to fit a large Portmeirion plate, and I rarely use it to wash pots or frying pans. Still, it is very helpful.

Even the quick cleaning settings aren't quick. I love the drawers and all the options to move pegs and even move drawers up and down. Though I wished the pegs didn't move on their own so easily. I'd love a setting option to leave this on while the door is open or at least extend the auto off so it doesn't go off so quickly. It can't be on for more than 30 seconds to a minute. The app feedback is wonderful; I appreciate the reminders to clean my filter and run a dishwasher cleaner through it.

Sentence (English): Bought this unit DW80R5061US and it worked fine for the first month.
Comments (English): [ Poor Design ] || ---------------- || Bought this unit DW80R5061US and it worked fine for the first month. After that the unit progressively got worse with its ability to clean dishes. There are two main issues with this design; filtration and the wash arms.First, the filtration system is junk. Unlike other brands, there is no easy way of cleaning the filter! You have to remove 15 Robertson screws to get to the upper pump area at the bottom of the wash tub. If some young wiz kid designer built this to save energy so you should never have to clean the filter, then the system should have a self cleaning function. Why is this an issue, I have food particles sticking to glassware, hardly washes the second row and useless for the third.Now, I've followed the “recommended” procedures (hot water/good water flow; high end dish soap/lots of high end rinse agent; it's level; it's loaded properly per the manual… everything Samsung has suggested). I've had older/other models where you could throw the carcass with the pan of Thanksgiving dinner and the pan would be spotless. This unit can't wash dried-on egg from forks and leaves so much food grit on glasses I might as well wash the dishes by hand. The middle wash wand is focused down so anything on the flimsy second rack gets little; apparently depending on the bottom wand to reach the 2nd level.The second issue has hinted above, the third rack is basically useless. It hardly washes anything on the 3rd row and as mentioned the second upper wand points most of its power down to the bottom rack. The adjustable rack is so flimsy you can barely put in a large coffee cup.Before Samsung support tells me how “sorry they are”, maybe you should rebate customers to buy your newest, more improved version before telling me this is a “rare occurrence”; since your testing was with clean plates. Geez your video states NOT use ever hole in the cutlery rack (never been an issue with older models). If you painstakingly use the 3rd upper rack for just cutlery, your 2nd rack doesn't get enough wash coming down. I suspect the issue is pump pressure and the tiny water heater to get to sanitize temp.With that said, if you put a mid-size load (properly loaded so dirty dishes face the middle/centre of the dishwasher), then use the storm-wash, full sanitize, high temp, it takes nearly 4 hrs to wash a load. And having to re-wash loads isn't saving any money, water or the climate.So having Canadian Thanksgiving we had to wash brunch for 6 people (4 hrs), dinner (2 loads @ 4 hrs) and the dishes were hit and miss. I hope the new fridge and stove I bought as a bundle last longer. This is a lemon of a design.

Sentence (English): I didn't have a reserved space and didn't want to make a hole, so I bought this one.

If you have particularly large bowls at home, or you want to wash the pots together, it is best to use a standard-sized built-in dishwasher. But this is a small one after all, so it’s pretty good.

Sentence (English): This is an amazing and fancy looking dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Super Quiet and Super Clean ] || ---------------- || This is an amazing and fancy looking dishwasher. Quiet without a doubt. We ran a sanitizing cycle, and it took a few hours. Really only need this on rare occasions but had to try it out. Lots of buttons and options and I still need the guide to program it. We'll mostly use normal. The dishes come out very clean and dry. One item placed on the top 3rd rack didn't clean very well but it really should have been on the bottom rack. The bottom rack was very difficult initially to push fully in until after running a few cycles. It's much easier now, still firm but not sticky. The top 2 racks move easily. The 2nd rack can be adjusted vertically giving more height to either the bottom or middle depending on whether the rack is adjusted up or down. The silverware bin is on the bottom and is a lot smaller than we're used to. However, the top 3rd rack can hold very flat items like silverware or measuring cups. It will get used since the silverware basket is small. Also, the 3rd rack can be adjusted to be a bit deeper. Installation Took an hour to install, not counting removal of the old one. The package does not include the water line hose or the connection part. You must have them before starting. The old machine was hardwired. We had to redo the electric, but they provide the 3-prong plug and a special outlet box which their plug is wired to directly. Connection to WI-FI took a few tries. I had to reset twice by holding the reset button for 4 seconds. The display refreshed and then the Wi-Fi connection worked. Not sure if I really need the app. The app allows for remote start and informs when a cycle is complete. You can set a default, it does tell you if it's running, if the door is open or when to add drying agents and when to clean the filter. Where this unit shines is how quiet it is, the cleaning which is why we have it and the options including sanitizing and drying.
